name: Cloze MCP
description: The Cloze MCP Server lets you securely access your Cloze data and take action. Whether you’re creating contacts, managing leads, prepping a listing, or launching a campaign - you can do it all via the Cloze MCP Server.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Cloze MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Cloze MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.cloze.com/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Cloze MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cloze MCP lists 20 MCP tools, including about_me, add_note, add_todo, full_content, person_add, person_change, person_count, person_find, person_find_steps, person_tags, person_views, and project_add.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Cloze MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Cloze MCP in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Cloze MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cloze MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Cloze MCP is developed by Cloze, Inc.. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
